ext_name.description: Extension name for store and browser UI

ext_description.message: New-tab speed dial of your bookmark tree — nested folders, local pictures, browser sync. No account.
ext_description.description: Extension description for store listing (CWS summary ≤132 characters)

unavailable_default.message: Hearth could not read browser bookmarks.

empty_folder.message: This folder has no bookmarks yet.

boot_extension_required.message: Open Hearth from a new tab after loading the extension in Chrome or Firefox.

image_from_url_help.message: Hearth downloads the image once and stores it locally. The dial does not keep linking to the remote URL.

error_name_bookmark.message: Name the bookmark and enter its address.

error_generic_bookmarks.message: Something went wrong while reading bookmarks.

error_thumbnails_http_only.message: Thumbnails work for http:// and https:// bookmarks only.

detail.example: Could not open a window to capture that page.

error_refresh_none.message: This folder has no http:// or https:// bookmarks to refresh.

help_tile_size.message: Width of each dial face (96–576px). Faces use a 16:9 aspect ratio.

switch_reverse_help.message: Newest or last-listed bookmarks appear at the start of the grid.

help_default_folder.message: Unset keeps recalling the last folder you had open. Set a folder and each new window / new tab starts there; navigating still updates last-open for when this is unset.

switch_thumbnails_help.message: Off by default. The first time you turn this on, the browser asks for optional access so Hearth can open a page briefly and capture a screenshot. Later turns may restore that access without asking. Images stay local — nothing is uploaded.

switch_image_url_help.message: Off by default. The first time you turn this on, the browser asks for optional site access so Hearth can download an image once from a link and store it locally. Turning it off drops active access; later turns may restore it without asking.

help_thumbnail_wait.message: How long capture waits after opening the page before taking the screenshot (1–15s, default 2). Raise this for slow sites.

storage_unavailable.message: Storage usage is unavailable right now.

danger_help.message: These actions only affect Hearth preferences and stored dial pictures — never your browser bookmarks.

settings_intro.message: Layout and theme preferences sync with your browser account when signed in. Dial pictures, wallpaper, and folder pins stay on this device. Bookmark order in the browser is unchanged — reverse only affects how the dial grid is shown.

note_saved.message: Saved. Open a new tab to see layout changes.

note_reset.message: Reset to defaults. Open a new tab to see layout changes.

note_erased.message: All Hearth data erased. Open a new tab to see the dial.

note_backup_downloaded.message: Backup downloaded. Browser bookmarks are not included.

note_import_overwrite.message: Backup imported (overwrite). Open a new tab to see the dial.

note_import_merge.message: Backup imported (merge). Open a new tab to see the dial.

boot_settings_required.message: Open Hearth settings from the extension after loading it in Chrome or Firefox.

preview_settings_banner.message: Preview mode — settings save in this browser’s localStorage.

preview_dial_banner.message: Preview with sample bookmarks. After you load the extension, a new tab uses your bookmark folders.

dial_storage_used_unlimited.message: About $1 used in this profile. No fixed size cap — still limited by free disk.

dial_storage_used_quota.message: About $1 of $2 available in this profile.

delete_link_confirm.message: Delete “$1”? This removes the bookmark from the browser.

delete_folder_filled_confirm.message: Delete folder “$1” and everything inside it? This cannot be undone from Hearth.

refresh_all_message.message: Recapture thumbnails for $1 $2 in this folder? Existing dial pictures for those bookmarks will be replaced. Nested folders are not included.

reset_defaults_message.message: Restore layout, display, theme, and picture preferences to product defaults. Your bookmarks and dial pictures stay.

erase_all_message.message: Permanently clear all Hearth settings, theme wallpaper, and stored dial pictures in this browser profile. Your browser bookmarks are not deleted.

error_thumbnail_permission_denied.message: Thumbnail capture needs permission to open pages and take a screenshot. You can enable it again in Settings.

error_image_url_permission_denied.message: Downloading an image from a URL needs permission. You can enable it again in Settings.

error_thumbnail_unavailable.message: Turn on “Generate dial thumbnails” in Settings first.

error_image_url_unavailable.message: Turn on “Assign pictures from URLs” in Settings first.

error_image_still_too_large.message: That image is still too large after resizing. Try a smaller or simpler file.

error_image_decode.message: That file could not be decoded as an image.

error_image_encode.message: That image could not be prepared for storage.

error_image_type.message: Choose a JPEG, PNG, GIF, or WebP image.

error_storage_quota.message: This browser profile is out of space for dial pictures. Remove some pictures or free disk space, then try again.

error_storage_write.message: Could not save that dial picture. Check that this profile has free disk space, then try again.

error_image_url_invalid.message: Enter an http:// or https:// image address.

error_image_read.message: That file could not be read as an image.

error_image_store.message: That file could not be stored as an image.

error_background_store.message: That file could not be stored as a background image.

error_bookmark_gone.message: That bookmark is no longer available.

error_root_cannot_move.message: The bookmarks root cannot be moved.

error_folder_into_self.message: A folder cannot be moved into itself.

error_folder_into_descendant.message: A folder cannot be moved into one of its subfolders.

error_screenshot_store.message: The page screenshot could not be stored as an image.

error_screenshot_too_large.message: That screenshot is too large to store. Try a simpler page, or attach a smaller image file.

error_capture_window.message: Could not open a window to capture that page.

error_extension_api_missing.message: Hearth requires a Chromium or Firefox extension API (browser / chrome).

import_invalid.message: That file is not a valid Hearth Speed Dial backup.

import_unsupported_version.message: Unsupported backup version ($1). This build reads version $2.

add_invalid.message: This page cannot be added as a dial.

add_no_folders_error.message: No bookmark folders are available yet.

boot_add_required.message: Open Add to Hearth from the extension context menu in Chrome or Firefox.

export_help.message: Download a JSON file of dial pictures, theme wallpaper, and layout preferences. Browser bookmarks are not included — the browser already syncs those.

import_help.message: Restore from a Hearth backup file. Choose overwrite (replace local Hearth data) or merge (keep pictures not in the file). Bookmarks are never changed.

import_mode_message.message: Overwrite replaces Hearth settings, theme wallpaper, and all dial pictures with the file. Merge updates settings and adds or replaces pictures from the file, keeping local pictures that are not in the backup. Browser bookmarks are never changed.

help_appearance.message: Auto (default) follows your system light/dark preference. Light and Dark lock the look.

help_accent.message: A small warm palette that keeps Hearth’s ember identity — not a full recolor.

help_page_color.message: Optional solid page wash override. Leave cleared so Appearance + Accent set the dial, Settings, and Add windows.

help_wallpaper.message: Stored in this browser profile only (same local store as dial pictures). Large images are resized before saving. No remote wallpapers.

help_opacity.message: How strongly the local wallpaper shows behind the dial (0–100%).

welcome_title.description: First-run welcome card heading on the new-tab dial

welcome_bookmarks.message: Your dials are ordinary browser bookmarks — the bookmark manager and browser sync see the same tree.

welcome_settings.message: The gear opens Settings for layout, theme, pictures, and backup.

welcome_picture.message: Use ⋮ → Picture… on a dial to assign a thumbnail or other local image.

welcome_privacy.message: No account — nothing leaves your browser.
